common.previewLimitationBody: This is non-irreversible scaffolding for later tasks. It does not fake authentication, messaging, calls, AI, or success behavior. The status banner in the app shell always reads “Not connected” until real transport exists. The only stored preferences are the appearance theme and interface language, and they stay in this browser.

auth.signIn.title: Sign in
auth.signIn.description: Preview the sign-in screen. No credentials are sent and no session is created.
auth.signIn.footer: New here? Create an account. You can also verify an email or recover a password.
auth.signIn.noticeBody: This screen exists to lock the layout and labels. Email/password sign-in, Google sign-in, sessions, and the 5-minute API token land in P1-06.
auth.signIn.passwordHint: Passwords are 12–128 characters. No password is checked in this preview.
auth.signIn.remember: Remember this browser for 30 days (preview only)
auth.signIn.status: Preview only: no credentials were sent and no session was created. Sign-in behavior lands in P1-06.
auth.signIn.googleMessage: Google sign-in is not implemented. No OAuth request was made; account linking is part of P1-06.
auth.signIn.googleHint: Google sign-in will require explicit account linking and a configured OAuth redirect.
auth.signUp.title: Create an account
auth.signUp.description: Preview the registration screen. No account is created and no email is sent.
auth.signUp.footerNext: Want to see the next screen?
auth.signUp.noticeBody: Account creation, the common/breached-password deny list, verification resend limits, and anti-enumeration behavior land in P1-06. This form does not call an API.
auth.signUp.emailHint: A verification email will be required before sign-in in the implemented flow.
auth.signUp.passwordHint: Use 12–128 characters. The local deny list and breach checks are not implemented in this preview.
auth.signUp.status: Preview only: no account was created, no email was sent, and no password was stored.
auth.signUp.googleMessage: Google registration is not implemented. No OAuth request was made; account linking is part of P1-06.
auth.signUp.googleHint: Google registration will require explicit account linking and a configured OAuth redirect.
auth.forgot.title: Forgot password
auth.forgot.description: Preview the recovery request screen. No recovery email is sent.
auth.forgot.footerRemembered: Remembered it? Return to sign in.
auth.forgot.noticeTitle: Password recovery is not implemented yet
auth.forgot.noticeBody: Email-only reset, token expiry, session revocation, and the generic anti-enumeration response land in P1-06. This form does not call an API.
auth.forgot.emailHint: The implemented flow returns the same response whether or not the email exists.
auth.forgot.status: Preview only: no email was sent. The implemented flow would return a generic response.
auth.reset.title: Reset password
auth.reset.description: Preview the reset-token screen. No token is read, and no password is changed.
auth.reset.footerNeed: Need a new link? Request password recovery.
auth.reset.noticeTitle: Password reset is not implemented yet
auth.reset.noticeBody: Token validation, single-use enforcement, expiry, session revocation, and the password deny list land in P1-06. Do not enter a real password here; this preview has no server.
auth.reset.passwordHint: 12–128 characters. No password is stored or checked in this preview.
auth.reset.status: Preview only: no token was read and no password was changed.
auth.verify.title: Verify your email
auth.verify.description: Preview the verification and resend states. No verification token is issued or checked.
auth.verify.footerOnce: Once verified, you would sign in.
auth.verify.noticeTitle: Email delivery is not implemented yet
auth.verify.noticeBody: Verification tokens, Resend delivery, resend limits, and the unverified-account cleanup land in P1-06. Nothing on this page contacts an email provider.
auth.verify.pendingDescription: The implemented flow will show this state until the emailed link is opened. This static preview cannot become verified.
auth.verify.emailHint: The implemented response is generic so it does not disclose whether an account exists.
auth.verify.status: Preview only: no email was sent and no resend limit was applied.
auth.layout.photoAlt: A couple silhouetted together against a warm sunset
auth.layout.photoBody: No credentials are sent, no session is created, and no account exists in this build. The photography is a local, user-supplied asset.
auth.layout.footer: Preview only — authentication is implemented in P1-06.
onboarding.page.photoAlt: A couple silhouetted together against a warm sunset
onboarding.page.photoTitle: A profile is a small introduction.
onboarding.page.photoBody: Three quiet steps. Nothing you type here is saved, sent, or checked against a real account.
onboarding.page.title: Make it feel like you
onboarding.page.description: This standalone flow previews the profile a partner would see. It is separate from the public profile route and is not connected to an account.
onboarding.page.footer: Preview only — no profile, username, bio, or timezone is stored. The interface language is remembered in this browser.
onboarding.form.steps.name: Name
onboarding.form.stepTitles.name: How should your partner see you?
onboarding.form.nameDescription: This is the name a partner would see. A generated initials avatar previews beside it.
onboarding.form.displayNameHint: 1–50 characters. The preview does not check or reserve this name.
onboarding.form.avatarText: The v1.0 avatar uses the first letter of the display name and a deterministic colour. There is no photo upload, no remote image, and no third-party avatar provider.
onboarding.form.usernameDescription: Usernames are for exact discovery only. This preview does not claim that a username is available.
onboarding.form.usernameHint: 3–24 lowercase ASCII letters, digits, or underscores. It must start with a letter. No availability check is made.
onboarding.form.formatText: {valid} is well formed. {invalid1} and {invalid2} are not.
onboarding.form.aboutDescription: All three fields are optional previews. Language applies immediately; timezone is display-only and no profile field is saved.
onboarding.form.bioHint: Preview only. The SRS does not define a bio field, so it is not saved or sent.
onboarding.form.bioPlaceholder: A sentence or two, if you like.
onboarding.form.languageHint: Changing this updates the interface immediately and remembers the choice in this browser.
onboarding.form.timezoneHint: Detected from this browser with a UTC fallback. No timezone preference is stored.
onboarding.form.errorName: Enter a display name between 1 and 50 characters.
onboarding.form.errorUsername: Use 3–24 characters, start with a lowercase letter, and use only lowercase letters, digits, or underscores.
onboarding.form.navNoteFinish: Finishing shows a notice; it does not save anything.
onboarding.form.completeBody: This was a UI preview. No profile, username, bio, or timezone was stored, sent, or checked for availability. The interface language is remembered in this browser only. Returning to the profile shows the synthetic sample data again.
conversations.title: A quiet place to talk
conversations.description: The conversation list and thread layout. No live data is loaded and no message can be sent.
conversations.noticeBody: This preview has no database or realtime connection. The empty state below is the truthful state for a new account; the sample row only demonstrates the planned layout.
conversations.emptyBody: When messaging is implemented, conversations created from exact-username discovery will appear here. Nothing is waiting for you in this preview.
conversations.sampleDescription: Synthetic content only. It is not stored, encrypted, or delivered.
conversations.sideBody: On desktop, this pane holds the thread. In this static preview only the labelled sample thread is available.
conversations.sideNote: No unread counts, presence dots, or live messages are shown.
conversations.statesTitle: Conversation states represented in this shell
conversations.stateLoadingDescription: A request-scoped loading state with a safe retry path; no cached plaintext is implied.
conversations.stateDisconnectedDescripti: The transport is unavailable. The shell must say so instead of showing a false connected state.
conversations.stateErrorDescription: A safe failure message with a correlation ID and a retry action; no stack trace or database detail.
thread.title: Conversation preview
thread.description: This route accepts a conversation ID, but the shell has no data source.
thread.noConversationDescription: No conversation with the ID “{id}” exists in this static preview. Only the labelled sample conversation is available.
thread.noticeBody: The messages below are synthetic layout samples. Sending, encryption, delivery, receipts, presence, typing, and history persistence are not implemented.
thread.actionNote: Both open labelled previews; neither starts a session.
thread.composerPlaceholder: Message composer preview — sending is not implemented
thread.composerHint: This field is read-only. The send control below only displays a preview notice; it does not create a message or contact a server.
thread.sendPreviewMessage: Sending is not implemented. No message was created, encrypted, or delivered.
thread.unknownOutcomeBadge: Unknown outcome is never shown as success
thread.sideBody: The thread is a layout sample. It has no server identity, no encryption state, and no delivery or read evidence.
thread.sideNote: AI is contextual here and in Settings. It is not a fifth tab.
thread.stateDisconnectedDescription: The shell shows a local disconnected state and keeps the last known messages readable; it never claims a live connection.
thread.stateUnknownDescription: An unknown outcome is not automatically a failure. The implemented client will reconcile with the original idempotency identity before offering a retry.
thread.stateInaccessibleDescription: A nonparticipant receives a safe rejection without conversation, message, or receipt data.
thread.statePresenceDescription: Participant-only presence and typing indicators are planned. This shell shows no live presence and does not send typing events.
thread.stateUnreadDescription: Per-conversation unread counts and read progress are planned. No unread state is loaded or stored in this preview.
thread.stateReceiptsDescription: Sending, sent, delivered, read, failed, and unknown outcome are distinct labels. Delivery and read labels appear only after qualifying evidence; a queued or unknown outcome is never shown as delivered.
thread.userContentNote: Sample message text stays in its original language; interface copy follows the selected language.
calls.title: A voice across the distance
calls.description: Call history and call-detail surfaces for one-to-one audio and video calls. No media session exists.
calls.noticeBody: Signaling, WebRTC, microphone and camera permission handling, TURN credentials, and call lifecycle state land in Phase 3. This page does not request media access.
calls.emptyDescription: A new account has no calls. The sample rows below only demonstrate the planned history layout.
calls.sampleDescription: Synthetic records. They are not stored and do not represent real calls.
calls.sideBody: The call stage is a cinematic preview with generated-avatar participant frames. It does not request a microphone, camera, or network path.
calls.sideNote: No screen share, recording, filters, or fake timer.
calls.statesTitle: Call states represented in this shell
calls.statePermissionDescription: Denied microphone or camera access produces clear guidance and never a false connected state. No capture remains.
calls.stateReconnectingDescription: A media or signaling interruption is shown as reconnecting under the approved timers; it is never concealed.
calls.stateRelayDescription: A relay-required network with unavailable TURN credentials fails safely with a relay-unavailable outcome.
call.title: Call preview
call.description: This route accepts a call ID, but the shell has no call data source.
call.noCallDescription: No call with the ID “{id}” exists in this static preview. Only the labelled sample call is available.
call.noticeBody: This is a static record. No camera or microphone access is requested, no signaling or peer connection is created, and the controls below only display preview notices.
call.stageHint: Controls are shown with their intended labels and states. They do not access devices or change a call. A muted track or denied permission is never shown as connected.
call.summaryDescription: Sample lifecycle record. No recording or raw media is stored.
call.noMediaStored: No recording or raw media stored
call.sideChatNote: The implemented call screen may show a text side chat. These messages are synthetic and are not sent.
call.controlMicrophoneMessage: Microphone control is not implemented. No device permission was requested and no audio track exists.
call.controlCameraMessage: Camera control is not implemented. No device permission was requested and no video track exists.
call.controlEndMessage: Ending a call is not implemented. There is no active call and no server request was made.
call.statePermissionDescription: The call fails with a permission-denied outcome, shows clear guidance, and releases any capture.
call.stateMediaDescription: The local UI shows reconnecting and applies the approved reconnect-or-end policy instead of pretending the call is healthy.
call.stateRelayDescription: On a relay-required network, missing or failed TURN credentials produce an explicit relay-unavailable failure.
call.stateLifecycleDescription: Ringing, connecting, connected, reconnecting, and terminal states are distinct. Delayed events cannot revive a terminal call, and local media state is shown separately from server state.
search.title: Find someone by exact username
search.description: Discovery is authenticated and limited to an exact, normalized username. Prefix, email, and phone search are intentionally unsupported.
search.noticeBody: Exact-username lookup, neutral no-result behavior, and blocked-user omission land in P1-17. This form does not call an API and does not disclose whether an account exists.
search.formBody: Usernames are 3–24 ASCII characters, start with a letter, and contain only lowercase letters, digits, and underscores.
search.usernameHint: The implemented search returns only userId, username, display name, and avatar reference.
search.status: Preview only: no search request was made. Exact-username discovery is implemented in P1-17.
search.note: No filters, prefix matching, email lookup, phone lookup, or “people you may know”.
search.sampleDescription: Synthetic result. It is not returned by a search and does not represent a real account.
search.stateNoMatchDescription: The implemented response is neutral and does not reveal whether an account exists.
search.stateUnsupportedDescription: Prefix search, email lookup, phone lookup, and “people you may know” are not part of v1.0.
search.stateSignInDescription: Discovery is authenticated. This static preview is visible, but the implemented route will require a session.
profile.title: Your profile
profile.description: Preview the signed-in profile surface. No account data is loaded and no profile change can be saved.
profile.noticeBody: Display name, username, email, locale, timezone, and avatar preferences are placeholders. Profile loading and editing land in P1-17.
profile.detailsDescription: These values are synthetic or unavailable. Nothing is read from an account.
profile.privacyBody: The v1.0 avatar is generated from the display name with a deterministic colour. There is no upload, external image request, or third-party avatar provider.
profile.privacyList4: No profile persistence in this preview
profile.privacyNote: Interface language is stored in this browser. Profile locale and timezone storage depend on P1-17 and DEC-023.
profile.stateAvatarDescription: The avatar is deterministic and decorative. The profile name remains the accessible label.
profile.statePersistenceDescription: This shell does not write profile fields. The appearance theme and interface language are the only stored UI preferences.
publicProfile.title: Profile preview
publicProfile.description: This route accepts a username, but the shell has no profile data source.
publicProfile.noProfileDescription: No profile for “{username}” exists in this static preview. Only the labelled sample profile is available.
publicProfile.noticeTitle: Profile and safety actions are placeholders
publicProfile.noticeBody: Blocking and reporting land in P1-18. Profile loading, editing, and discovery land in P1-17. The actions below only display a preview notice.
publicProfile.safetyDescription: These controls are labelled previews. They do not record a block or create a report.
publicProfile.blockMessage: Blocking is not implemented. No block was recorded and no request was sent; the blocking flow lands in P1-18.
publicProfile.reportMessage: Reporting is not implemented. No report was created and no content was selected or sent; reporting lands in P1-18.
publicProfile.blockHint: The implemented block is silent to the blocked user. The blocker sees an explicit state, and new conversation or call attempts receive a generic unavailable response.
publicProfile.reportHint: Reports will require an approved reason. Decrypted excerpts are optional, selected by the reporter, previewed before consent, and never attached automatically.
publicProfile.contextBody: No online status, verification badge, follower count, photo grid, or activity feed is displayed. The profile is deliberately limited to the fields the SRS defines.
publicProfile.stateBlockedDescription: The blocker sees “You blocked this user” and cannot send. The blocked user sees no block disclosure; outbound sends fail with a generic unavailable state.
publicProfile.stateUnavailableDescriptio: Blocked users are omitted from discovery and cannot create a new conversation with the blocker. The response is neutral.
settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Preview the account, appearance, privacy, language, data, and session settings. The appearance theme and interface language are stored in this browser.
settings.noticeBody: There is no session, preference store, or account API in this shell. Controls are disabled or display a preview notice. The appearance theme and interface language are the approved local exceptions. The related implementation tasks are P1-11, P1-17, and P1-18.
settings.accountDescription: Session and account data are not loaded. Sign-out behavior is part of P1-06.
settings.signOutMessage: Sign out is not implemented. No session exists and no request was made.
settings.signOutHint: The implemented flow will revoke the Better Auth session and clear the in-memory token.
settings.appearanceDescription: Choose a light, dark, or system-following theme. This preference is stored in this browser.
settings.profileDescription: Display name, username, and avatar editing land in P1-17. The avatar is generated from initials; there is no upload.
settings.privacyDescription: Privacy controls are placeholders. No consent, receipt preference, or block record is stored.
settings.readReceiptsHint: Opt-in and default off. Sending receipts is reciprocal once enabled. Not saved in this preview.
settings.aiProcessingHint: Real-content AI is release-gated. No per-action consent is recorded in this shell.
settings.blockedDescription: No blocked users are loaded. Blocking, unblocking, and reporting land in P1-18.
settings.previewSafetyProfile: Preview a profile with safety actions
settings.languageDescription: English and Bengali catalogs and locale-aware timestamps are implemented. The interface language is stored in this browser; timezone storage is not.
settings.interfaceLanguageHint: Changing this updates the interface immediately. The choice is stored in this browser only.
settings.displayTimezoneHint: Times are formatted for the selected language and the browser timezone, with UTC as the fallback.
settings.languageSavedNote: The interface language is stored in this browser only. Timezone is display-only and is not persisted.
settings.dataDescription: Export, deletion, and session revocation are not implemented. The descriptions below reflect the recorded policy, not an enabled feature.
settings.exportHint: The planned export is an encrypted recovery archive. A server-side plaintext export is not advertised.
settings.exportMessage: Export is not implemented. No archive was created and no data was read.
settings.deleteHint: The recorded flow uses a 7-day grace period and a tombstone; recipient local copies cannot be recalled.
settings.deleteMessage: Account deletion is not implemented. No deletion request was recorded.
settings.otherSessionsHint: There is no session store in this shell. Revoking other sessions will be part of the auth implementation.
settings.revokeMessage: Session revocation is not implemented. No session was revoked.
settings.aiDescription: AI is contextual: it appears in a conversation and here. Real-content AI is release-gated, and no provider is called in this build.
states.title: UI states
states.description: A static gallery of the shared states used across the shell. Each panel is illustrative; none reports live status.
states.noticeBody: These panels show the wording and structure required by the error model. They are not triggered by a request, socket, provider, or media device on this page.
states.loadingDescription: Used for request-scoped progress. The implemented view names the operation and offers cancellation where the contract supports it.
states.emptyDescription: Used when a valid request has no results. The copy stays neutral and offers a safe next action.
states.errorDescription: Used for a safe failure with a correlation ID and a retry path. Stack traces, database internals, and raw provider errors are never shown.
states.disconnectedDescription: Used when the transport or media path is unavailable. The UI says so and never keeps a false connected state.
states.unauthorizedDescription: Used for an expired session or an inaccessible resource. The approved contract decides when the response is deliberately uniform.
states.unsupportedDescription: Used for an unsupported capability, browser feature, AI release gate, or relay-required network without TURN.
states.infoDescription: Used for non-error context such as pending verification, preview limitations, or privacy disclosures.
states.keyRecoveryDescription: Used when a device key is missing or lost. The user needs the recovery flow, and the UI must not promise recovery that the reviewed key lifecycle cannot provide.
states.permissionDescription: Used when browser microphone or camera permission was denied. The user must change the browser permission before a new call attempt; the shell never leaves a false connected state.
states.mapChats: Chats: empty list, loading history, disconnected transport, and history failure.
states.mapThread: Conversation detail: unknown send outcome, disconnected transport, and inaccessible conversation.
states.mapSearch: Search: neutral no-result, unsupported search mode, and sign-in required.
states.mapCalls: Calls and call detail: permission denied, reconnecting, and relay unavailable.
states.mapAi: AI: request progress, provider failure, and missing consent or authorization.
states.mapAuth: Authentication: pending verification, generic recovery response, and preview-only notices.
states.errorCodesDescription: The client maps stable error codes to reviewed copy. Raw provider, database, or stack-trace text is never displayed.
states.rawProviderNote: A deliberately unknown provider message maps to the generic error copy instead of being shown.
ai.title: Help, only when you ask
ai.description: Informational placeholders for smart replies, translation, and summaries. Real-content AI is disabled.
ai.noticeBody: DEC-026 requires privacy and legal sign-off, per-action consent, disclosure, and provider-integration evidence before real message content is processed. No consent is recorded here, no content is sent, and no AI provider is called.
ai.unavailableDescription: The three AI features are MVP capabilities, but this shell exposes only their surfaces. Provider failure must never block authentication, history, or calls.
ai.featureSmartDescription: Suggestions generated only from the selected message context. The user can review, edit, copy, or discard a suggestion; nothing is sent automatically.
ai.featureTranslateDescription: A selected message translated into an approved target language. The translation is labelled separately and the original stays unchanged.
ai.featureSummaryDescription: A summary of a bounded, user-selected conversation range. It is displayed separately with a notice that it may omit or misstate information.
ai.consentBody: The implemented flow will show the selected content, the requested action, the provider, and the retention terms before any request. Consent is per action and can be withdrawn.
ai.consentList1: The selected message or bounded range
ai.consentList2: The chosen action and target language
ai.consentList3: The provider and what it receives
ai.consentList4: How to cancel and how long the result is kept
ai.consentCheck: I understand this consent is a preview
ai.consentHint: Disabled. No consent is recorded, and no request can be made from this page.
ai.statesTitle: AI states represented in this shell
ai.stateProgressDescription: Each AI operation has its own loading and cancellation state. Cancellation prevents a later result from being inserted automatically.
ai.stateProviderDescription: A safe failure message with a deliberate retry option. Original messages remain accessible and core chat is unaffected.
ai.stateConsentDescription: No AI request is made without the current participant context and per-action consent for the selected content.
status.errorDescription: The shell could not render this route. No message, call, or AI request is implied by this error. Try again, or return to a known surface.
status.notFoundDescription: This route does not exist in the UI shell. Check the address or return to a known surface.
status.loadingDescription: No session, message, call, or AI data is being fetched.
status.appLoadingDescription: The route is rendering. This static shell does not fetch session, message, call, or AI data.
status.authLoadingDescription: The account surface is rendering. No credentials are sent by this preview.
documentTitle.description: A static, labelled preview of the one-to-one chat and calling interface. No live services are connected.
sample.call.message1: This is a synthetic sample message. It previews the conversation layout without using real content.
sample.call.message2: The composer below is a preview. Sending, delivery, receipts, and encryption are not implemented yet.
sample.call.message3: Loading, empty, error, and disconnected states are documented in the UI state gallery.

sample.call.profileBio: Synthetic profile used to preview the public profile layout.
errors.unknown.title: Something went wrong
errors.unknown.description: A safe failure occurred. Try again, or return to a known surface. No provider or database detail is shown.
errors.INVALID_REQUEST.title: Check the request
errors.INVALID_REQUEST.description: Some required information was missing or malformed. Review the form and try again.
errors.INVALID_CURSOR.title: This page expired
errors.INVALID_CURSOR.description: The history cursor is invalid or belongs to another conversation. Reload the conversation to continue.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED.title: Sign in required
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED.description: Your session is missing or expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.SESSION_REVOKED.title: Session ended
errors.SESSION_REVOKED.description: This session is no longer valid. Sign in again to continue.
errors.FORBIDDEN.title: Not available
errors.FORBIDDEN.description: This action is not available for this account or conversation.
errors.DEVICE_REVOKED.title: Device revoked
errors.DEVICE_REVOKED.description: This device is no longer authorized for encryption keys. Sign in on a new device and restore or reset encryption.
errors.NOT_FOUND.title: Not found
errors.NOT_FOUND.description: The requested item is absent or not visible to this account.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.title: Message conflict
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.description: The same send identity was reused with different content. The original message was not changed.
errors.DEVICE_REPLACEMENT_REQUIRED.title: Device replacement required
errors.DEVICE_REPLACEMENT_REQUIRED.descr: This account already has an active encryption device. Restore your encrypted backup or explicitly reset encryption; authentication alone cannot add another device.
errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.title: Too large
errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.description: The request exceeds the approved size limit. Shorten it and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED.title: Too many requests
errors.RATE_LIMITED.description: The approved limit was reached. Wait a moment before trying again.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION.title: Update required
errors.UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION.descri: This client version is not supported. Update the app before continuing.
errors.CLIENT_UPGRADE_REQUIRED.title: Update required
errors.CLIENT_UPGRADE_REQUIRED.descripti: A required contract changed. Update the app before continuing.
errors.TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE.title: Temporarily unavailable
errors.TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE.descripti: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR.title: Something went wrong
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR.description: An unexpected failure occurred. Try again, or return to a known surface.
